data.long_meaning: The name Pammi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Pam’ which means ‘loving’ and ‘mi’ which means ‘mother’. The name Pammi is a beautiful name for a baby girl, evoking feelings of love and nurturing. The name Pammi carries the meaning “Loving Mother” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Telugu, Marathi. Parents who choose Pammi usually hope their child will grow to embody loving mother and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Pammi is considered sacred in Hinduism as it is associated with the divine mother Goddesses. It is believed that a child named Pammi will be blessed with love, care, and nurturing.
data.etymology: Pammi belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Loving Mother.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pammi total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
